name: flights.planeside/planeside
title: Planeside
description: Private-terminal prices, access rules and booking links. No payment taken.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Use this when you need private airport terminals matching an airport or IATA code, city, country, region, service type, maximum price, or per-person versus per-group pricing. Returns compact entries with sources, the operator booking link (ref=planeside-mcp), the Planeside page to cite, and a note that prices are indicative. Default results are open (live) or announced (soon). Read-only. Does not book or take payment.

query.description: Free-text match against name, operator, airport, city, country, and IATA code.

airport.description: IATA code such as LHR or LAX, or part of the airport name such as Heathrow.

city.description: City name, for example Paris or London.

country.description: Country name or a distinctive substring, for example United or Singapore.

region.description: Planeside region. One of Europe, Americas, Asia, Gulf, Africa, Oceania.

service_type.description: private_terminal returns every indexed service (they all are). bookable means you can pay. not_for_sale means access comes with a ticket or status.

max_price.description: Maximum for the indexed price figure, in `currency`. That figure is the first amount in the published price. Comparison uses approximate editorial rates and is for filtering only. It does not convert per-person and per-group prices onto one basis. The returned price_from is the operator figure, unconverted. Rows with no verified price are omitted.

currency.description: ISO currency for max_price. Defaults to USD. One of GBP, USD, EUR, SGD, BHD, CHF.

price_basis.description: How the published price scales. per_person is one traveller. per_group is one price for the party. tiered is a first guest plus each additional guest. Omit to include every basis. Rows whose basis is not yet verified are omitted when this is set.

status.description: live = open now, soon = announced, closed = no longer operating, any = all three. Default: live and soon.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Use this when you have a Planeside service id and need the full entry: access rules, price, transfer, FAQ, sources, booking link, and the canonical page to cite. Prices are indicative. Read-only. Unpublished candidate ids return an error. Does not book or take payment.

id.description: Service id from search_services, for example ps-lax or windsor-lhr.

tools.name: list_airports
tools.description: Use this when you need every airport that has a private terminal which is open or announced, grouped by IATA code. Each terminal includes its status, sources, and booking link. Closed terminals are omitted. Prices are indicative. Read-only.

tools.name: compare_services
tools.description: Use this when you need two to five Planeside services side by side. Pass their ids. Each side includes price, access, sources, and the booking link, plus a note when currencies or per-person versus per-group bases differ so the numbers are not treated as equivalent. Prices are indicative. Read-only. Does not rank a winner, book, or take payment.

ids.description: Two to five service ids to compare. Duplicates are rejected.

tools.name: request_arrangement
tools.description: Use this when a person wants Planeside to arrange a live terminal whose arrangeable field is true. Records the request only. This is a request, not a booking; no payment taken; we'll confirm availability and price by email. This request is for the terminal only. It must not be packaged with a flight sale (UK Package Travel Regulations 2018 / ATOL). consent must be true or nothing is stored. It is not a booking and it takes no payment. Do not pass a flight, a fare, or a ticket.

service_id.description: Id of a live terminal with arrangeable true, for example ps-lax.

travel_date.description: Travel date, YYYY-MM-DD. Today or later.

airport.description: Airport, as an IATA code or a name.

notes.description: Optional note. Do not include a flight booking.

consent.description: Must be true. The person agrees to Planeside storing these details and emailing them. False stores nothing.
